Maria L: quick postmortem follow-up from yesterday's canary — we saw the same partial-rollout pattern (slow error spike + manual rollback). need owners + short timelines for: auto-rollback rules, flag scoping (blast radius limits), deterministic sampling, and playbook updates.

Samir P: I can own the auto-rollback prototype and tests. aiming for a working spike by Fri.

Jess C: can we also require a safe fallback model variant on rollback? avoids traffic blackholes.

Andrew S: i'll take flag scoping and the playbook wording changes. will draft runbook changes next week.

Samir P: proposed quick config for rollback threshold (we can iterate):
```yaml
canary:
  max_error_rate: 0.05   # 5%
  window: 180s
  rollback: true
  blast_radius_limit: 2%
```

Samir P: will add integration test to simulate 6% error within window and assert rollback triggers.

deploy-bot: created INF-4129: canary-auto-rollback-prototype (assignee: Samir P)

deploy-bot: created INF-4130: flag-scoping-and-playbook (assignee: Andrew S)

Jess C: :thumbsup: assigning product review to me, i'll validate UX and fallback paths by Tue.

Andrew S: scheduling a monthly canary drill + playbook review on the ops calendar. first drill: 2 weeks from now.

Maria L: summary / owners: Samir = auto-rollback + tests (ETA Fri), Andrew = flag scoping + playbook (ETA Wed next week), Jess = product review (ETA Tue). i'll run a short check-in next Tue 10:00 to close the loop. please update INF-4129/INF-4130 with status. thanks! :white_check_mark:
